mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe economic distress that triggers immediate risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate broad demand collapse, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-2008 financial crisis recovery phase, near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) sustain equity valuations through low discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the post-2008 recovery period, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer Price Index exceeding 215.0 signals accelerating inflation that triggers imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate accelerating labor market recovery, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and business investment, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
